description: Self-authored (not sourced from any corpus, not written by PlumePdf's own writer) two-column page. Critically, the CONTENT STREAM writes the right column's three lines before the left column's three lines — the opposite of the expected reading order — so this fixture only passes if the reading-order heuristic actually reasons about column geometry rather than falling back to raw content-stream/paint order. Expected reading order ('top-to-bottom-columns-left-to-right'): all of the left column, top to bottom, then all of the right column, top to bottom.

oracle.method: hand-derived from the known content-stream operators (see generator): each column is 3 lines of 12pt Helvetica, left column text-origin x=20, right column x=210, first line y=150 then Td-relative (0,-20) per subsequent line.
oracle.notes: indexInPage for the two anchor letters below is computed from the exact character length of the left column's text ("Left column line one." = 21 chars, "Left column line two." = 21 chars, "Left column line three." = 23 chars; total 65), confirming the right column's first letter is expected to sort AFTER the entire left column, not interleaved by y-coordinate.

pages.expectedText:
Left column line one.
Left column line two.
Left column line three.
Right column line one.
Right column line two.
Right column line three.

letters.note: First letter overall: start of left column, line 1.
First letter of the right column's first line — must sort after all 65 left-column letters despite being painted first in the content stream.
